cell/Sales.xlsx!Apr!H1: April's output VAT, as the sales month tab totals it. The VAT view's interface table prints the same figure in its "Month VAT output" column for that period; this is the source tab's own copy.
cell/Sales.xlsx!Apr!H2: The book's VAT rate, which every sales month tab repeats. It is a constant of the book rather than a figure of April, and no view prints it twelve times.
cell/Sales.xlsx!Apr!I1: April's sales net of VAT, as the sales month tab totals it. The VAT view's interface table prints the same figure in its "Month sales" column for that period; this is the source tab's own copy.
cell/Sales.xlsx!Apr!W1: The CIS contractors deducted from April's sales. No view prints CIS month by month; the year's total reaches the Income Tax view as the tax taken off at source.
cell/Sales.xlsx!Apr!X1: The CIS deducted from the year's sales up to and including April. No view prints the running total; March's figure is what the Income Tax view takes off the bill.
cell/Purchases.xlsx!Apr!A1: April's balancing residue: gross less VAT less every analysed column. The tab's own proof that its analysis columns account for the month, not a figure of the book.
cell/Purchases.xlsx!Apr!A2: The mileage claim to the end of April. No view prints the mileage claim; it reaches the profit and loss account inside the month's own net purchases total.
